title: WEATHER FORECAST FOR 31 JULY 2026 Issued at 05.30 a.m. on 31 July 2026. Showers will occur at times in Western, Sabaragamuwa and North-western provinces and in Kandy, Nuwara-Eliya, Galle and Matara districts. Heavy falls above 100 mm are likely at some places. A few showers may occur in Anuradhapura and Hambantota districts. Mainly dry weather will prevail over the other areas of the island. Strong winds of about (40-50) kmph can be expected at times over Northern, North-central, North-western and Central provinces and in Rathnapura, Monaragala, Hambantota and Trincomalee districts.
